description: Erection of single storey rear extension to the existing garage to provide a gym to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (TQRQM21167122440321 & TQRQM21167121527624 (received 16 June 2021);   AS/1 & AS/2 (received 30 June 2021); AS/3; AS/4 (received 11 August 2021)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied or used at any time other than for purposes specified on the plans hereby approved or other such uses which are incidental to the use of the dwelling known as 12 Redford Close
